name: omnisense/omnistay
description: Omnistay: where to stay and what to book for a trip, under any PHP host, whoever sells it - hotels and homes rented by their owners searched through one interface, a property's availability, nightly rates, fees, taxes and cancellation policy, offers re-priced, bookings made and cancelled, a property's description and calendar; car hire and packages as shared models. Providers are packages of their own (omnistay/amadeus for hotels, omnistay/local for a site's own listings).

suggest.omnistay/amadeus: Hotels through Amadeus' hotel APIs: a city's or a point's hotels, their offers, an offer re-priced, a booking (a client id and secret)
suggest.omnistay/local: A site's own listings as a provider: homes rented by their hosts, their calendar, seasonal prices, minimum stays, bookings held without double booking
suggest.omnisense/omnibridge: The host contracts; omnibridge/symfony and omnibridge/laravel wire omnistay into their host when a site needs it
